Name: Nisha
RulesText: Before the game begins, choose a faction. Nisha is that faction.\nAfter starting armies are revealed, choose up to two classes. Nisha permanently gains those classes.

Name: Noble Sacrifice
RulesText: Spend React: After your character is targeted by a strike or action, and if this character is in a first rank, kill this character: Cancel the strike or action.

Name: Nog, Pog, and Snivels
RulesText: Enter React: Perform a melee strike.\nDeath React: Perform a melee strike. Banish Nog, Pog, and Snivels.

Name: Nothrog S'sike
RulesText: React: After target opposing character moves to within one rank of this character, spend Nothrog S'sike: Perform a melee strike against the target.

Name: Novice Pyro
RulesText: Spend Order: Perform a +2 ranged strike.

Name: Oracle of Kavara
RulesText: Spend Order: Discard a card: Survey. Draw a card.

Name: Out of Options
RulesText: Your deck may include any number of cards named Out of Options\nOrder: This character gains your choice of +2 ATK or AC this turn.

Name: Overburdened Nag
RulesText: Order: Spend Overburdened Nag: Move forward one rank.

Name: Pack Tactics
RulesText: Spend Order: Your two target characters attack (spending as normal).

Name: Percy Dorn
RulesText: Spend Order: Perform a +0 ranged strike.

Name: Pin Down
RulesText: Order: Perform a +0 ranged strike. If the strike hits, the target may not move this turn unless falling forward.\nSpend React: After target opposing character moves without spending: Spend the target.

Name: Pious Rebuke
RulesText: Spend React: Before target opposing character performs a melee strike: The target must succeed with a will save (DC 10 + this character's skill) or the strike is canceled and the target performs a melee strike against a character in their army.

Name: Polymorph
RulesText: Order: Target your character: This turn, the target's base stats become level 2, +3/+3 ATK, 13 AC, +3 skill, and 2 HP, and they gain the Monster trait.

Name: Pounce
RulesText: Order: Move forward one rank.\nSpend React: After target character performs a melee strike that missed: Inflict a wound on the target.

Name: Premonition Pendant
RulesText: Order: Spend Premonition Pendant: Survey.

Name: Press the Attack
RulesText: Spend Order: Target any number of your fighters: Each target moves forward one rank. Each target that moved may perform a +3 melee strike.

Name: Prime Positioning
RulesText:
Roll Order:
1-9: Move forward one rank.
10-19: This character gains +5 ATK this turn. Move forward one rank.
20: This character gains +5 ATK this turn. Move forward one rank. Perform a +15 melee strike.

Name: Punitive Strike
RulesText: React: Before this character makes a melee strike roll: The strike gains +3 ATK.\nOrder: Perform a melee strike that may only target a stunned character.

Name: Quartermaster Dirge
RulesText: Death React: Target Dwarven Forges character gains +1 level for equipping items this turn and another target character suffers -1 level for equipping items this turn.

Name: Quazlan Rivet
RulesText: While Encumbered, Quazlan Rivet gains +5 ATK and an additional melee strike (base +0) while attacking.

Name: Quick Dodge
RulesText: React: After this character is targeted with a strike: This character gains +5 AC for the strike.

Name: Quick Shielding
RulesText: React: After target character within two ranks is targeted with a strike: The target gains a bonus to AC equal to this character's level this turn.

Name: Quick Strength
RulesText: React: Before target character within two ranks makes a melee strike roll: The target gains a bonus to ATK equal to this character's level this turn.

Name: Quicksilver Gargoyle
RulesText: Limited React: Before Quicksilver Gargoyle suffers wounds: Ready it. This action may be performed while stunned.

Name: Ra'gar Root-Strength
RulesText: Ra'Gar Root-Strength and your adjacent characters inflict an additional wound with melee strikes targeting Encumbered characters.

Name: Ramesh, Elder Sage
RulesText: After starting armies are revealed, choose a class. Ramesh, Elder Sage permanently gains that class.\nLimited Order: Your other target Mercenary Guilds character gains +2 ATK and AC this turn.

Name: Rapid Dash
RulesText:
Roll Order:
1-9: Journey.
10-19: Journey. Perform an Order.
20: Move to the first rank of any formation. Gain Stealth +10 this turn.

Name: Recruiter of Misear
RulesText: Spend React: After an opposing character enters play: Put a character into play. If you control a Mercenary Guilds Warlord, you may reduce the character's entering rank by one.

Name: Resurrection
RulesText: Spend Order: Discard a card, target an equal or lower level character in your discard pile: Put the target into your hand.

Name: Retreat from the Roil
RulesText: Spend Order: Target each character in a rank within two ranks: Each target must succeed with a reflex save (DC 15) or move backward one rank.

Name: Revenger
RulesText: This character gains Dual Wield.\nThis character inflicts an additional wound with melee strikes while they have two or more Weapons equipped.

Name: Revitalizing Roots
RulesText: Spend Order: Target up to three characters: Heal each target.

Name: Riding Horse
RulesText: Order: Spend Riding Horse: Move forward one rank.

Name: Ritual Dagger
RulesText: This character gains +2 ATK for each wounded character in play.

Name: Rockarm
RulesText: React: Before this character performs a melee strike, spend Rockarm: The strike inflicts an additional wound.

Name: Rone of the Deepbrook
RulesText: Your characters gain "Enter React: Perform a +1 ranged strike."

Name: Rrok
RulesText: Wounds inflicted by Rrok's melee strikes may not be reduced.\nLimited Order: Move forward one rank.

Name: Sacrifice
RulesText: React: Before your target character suffers wounds, this character suffers a wound: Reduce the wounds the target suffers by one.

Name: Salvage
RulesText: Limited React: Before target Dwarven Forges character is killed: Return an Armor, Shield, or Weapon equipped to the target to its owner's hand.

Name: Sanguicorn
RulesText: Sanguicorn's melee strikes inflict an additional wound if the roll is odd.\nLimiter Order: Move Forward one rank.

Name: Sarakian SellSword
RulesText: Sarakian Sellsword is the same alignment, factions, and classes as your Warlords.

Name: Scale Mail
RulesText: This character gains +2 AC while targeted with a ranged strike.

Name: Scepter of Djarat
RulesText: Order: Spend Scepter of Djarat: Target character within two ranks must succeed with a reflex save (DC 15) or spend and suffer a wound. Characters that were adjacent to the target must succeed with a reflex save (DC 10) or spend.

Name: Scout Pony
RulesText: Order: Spend Scout Pony: Journey.

Name: Seeker
RulesText: After starting armies are revealed, chose a class. Seeker permanently gains that class.\nLimited Order: Your other target Dwarven Forges character gains +1 HP this turn.

Name: Shadow Bolts
RulesText: Spend Order: Perform a +4 ranged strike. If this character is a rogue, this strike inflicts an additional wound against spent characters. If this character is a wizard, perform another +4 ranged strike.

Name: Shambling Horror
RulesText: Characters killed by Shambling Horror are banished instead.

Name: Shannon the Daring
RulesText: Adjacent level 1 and 2 characters gain +2 ATK.\nLimited React: After Shannon enters play or performs a melee strike: Level 1 and 2 Free Kingdoms characters in your first rank gain +2 ATK and AC this turn.

Name: Shatter
RulesText: Order: If this character is in a first rank, destroy target item in a first rank.

Name: Shield of Spurning
RulesText: React: After target character performs a melee strike targeting this character, spend Shield of Spurning: Move the target backward one rank.

Name: Shield Rune
RulesText: Order: Equip a Simple Shield token to your target character.\nSpend React: After a character is targeted by a ranged strike: Cancel the strike.

Name: Shillelagh
RulesText: This character gains a bonus to ATK equal to half their skill, rounded up.

Name: ShockSaber
RulesText: This character gains advantage on melee strikes targeting Planar characters.\nReact: After this character is targeted with a ranged strike, spend Shocksaber: Gain +10 AC for the duration of the strike.

Name: Shrapnelball
RulesText: Destroy Order: Target up to three characters within two ranks: Perform a +0 ranged strike against each target.

Name: Shyessa the Weaver
RulesText: Your characters have "Death React: Survey." Limited Order: Discard up to two cards: Draw a card for each card discarded.

Name: Silversteel Gauntlets
RulesText: React: Before this character targets a strike, spend Silversteel Gauntlets: This character gains True Strike for the strike.

Name: Simple Shield
RulesText: Destroy React: Before this character suffers wounds: Reduce the wounds by one.

Name: Sister Amanda
RulesText: Sister Amanda enters play as level 5.\nLimited Spend React: After target Free Kingdoms character performs a Spend Order: Ready the target.

Name: Sister Kiren
RulesText: Limited Order: Your target higher level Deverenian Empire character Journeys.

Name: Skitterleap
RulesText: Skitterleap's spells inflict an additional wound against spent characters.\nReact: After your character dies: Spend target lower level character within two ranks.

Name: Sklot the Cruel
RulesText: Order: Twice per turn, destroy an equipped item: Perform a +6 ranged strike. After the strike, each character that was adjacent to the target must succeed with a reflex save (DC 12) or suffer a wound and spend.

Name: Skulk in the shallows
RulesText:
Roll Spend Order:
1-9: Your target equal or lower level character Journeys.
10-19: Up to two of your target equal or lower characters Journey.
20: Any number of your target equal or lower level characters Journey.

Name: Sleep
RulesText: Spend Order: Target two level 1 characters or one level 2 character. Each target must succeed with a magic save (DC 13) or stun.

Name: Sneak
RulesText: React: After this character is targeted with a non-attack action: Succeed with a perception check (DC 18) to cancel the action.

Name: Sneak Attack
RulesText: Order: Perform a +4 melee strike that may only target a spent character.

Name: Solar Ray
RulesText: Order: Target character within two ranks must succeed with a will save (DC = 5 + this character's skill) or suffer a wound. Undead characters suffer two wounds instead.

Name: Spiked Pit Trap
RulesText: Spend Order: Target a rank: Whenever a character moves into that rank this turn, they must succeed with a reflex save (DC 12) or suffer a wound.

Name: Spiritual Weapon
RulesText: Order: Perform a melee strike with a bonus equal to this character's level. This character gains Reach for the strike.

Name: Spit Fire
RulesText: Spend Order: Target character within two ranks must succeed with a reflex save (DC 13) or suffer a wound. If this character is a Dragon, target up to two characters instead.

Name: Squire Argos
RulesText: Other equal or lower level Free Kingdoms characters in this rank gain +2 ATK and +1 AC.

Name: Squire Fendric
RulesText: Limited Order: Spend a character in this rank: Move forward one rank. If Squire Fendric moves, he may perform a melee strike.

Name: Squire Parthus
RulesText: Spend Order: Perform a number of melee strikes equal to Squire Parthus' level.

Name: Sta'ash
RulesText: React: Before target character is killed by Sta'ash: If the target is higher level, heal (remove a wound from) Sta'ash. If the target is lower level, banish it after it dies.

Name: Starbinder
RulesText: Limited React: After your target character moves: The target gains your choice of +3 ATK or AC this turn.

Name: Steady Grip
RulesText: Order: This character gains +2 ATK and True Strike this turn.

Name: Steel Darts
RulesText: Order: Spend Steel Darts: Perform a +0 ranged strike.

Name: Steelforge Regalia
RulesText: Kill React: Twice per turn: Perform a melee strike.

Name: Stirges
RulesText: Limited React: After Stirges perform a melee strike that hit: Perform a melee strike.

Name: Storm Shard
RulesText: Order: Ready each of your Warlords. Draw a card for each Warlord readied this way. Banish Storm Shard. Characters may not react to or during this action.

Name: Storm's Attendant
RulesText: Limited Order: If Storm's Attendant is adjacent to a higher level character: Survey (Look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put any number of them on top or bottom in any order.)

Name: Stormlord
RulesText: At end of turn kill your Dev character or kill this character.

Name: Strongarm Stout
RulesText: Destroy Order: Each player draws a card. This turn, this character gains +2 ATK and +1 HP for each card drawn this way.

Name: Summon Avalanche
RulesText: Spend Order: Target each character in a rank within two ranks: Each target must succeed with a reflex save (DC 14) or spend. Spent characters stun instead. Stunned characters suffer a wound instead.

Name: Sunfire Aegis
RulesText: React: After target adjacent character is targeted with a strike, spend Sunforge Aspis: The target gains +2 AC for the strike.

Name: Sunforge Smith
RulesText: Spend Order: Target your wounded Dwarven Forges character: Unstun the target, or the target performs a +2 melee strike.

Name: Sunseeker's Goggles
RulesText: +2 skill

Name: Sutek Razorclaw
RulesText: Sutek Razorclaw's melee strikes may target spent characters an additional rank away.

Name: Sutek Shank
RulesText: This character's melee strikes inflict an additional wound against stunned characters.\nDeath React: Equip this item to an adjacent Sutek ignoring level requirements.

Name: Sutek Slimefang
RulesText: Death React: Spend target opposing character within one rank.

Name: Swampbook
RulesText: +1 Skill\nReact: After another character within one rank is targeted by a strike, spend Swampbook: Redirect the strike to a character adjacent to the strike's original target.

Name: Swift
RulesText: Order: Journey.

Name: Switftcloud
RulesText: Limited Order: Journey.\nLimited Order: Put a character into play from your hand ignoring loyalty penalty. If it is a Mercenary Guilds character, you may reduce it's entering rank by one.

Name: Swivel
RulesText: React: Before this character targets a ranged strike: Gain Marksmanship +5 for the strike. Journey.

Name: Tazian Dythanus
RulesText: Limited Order: Target up to two characters in any discard piles: Banish the targets. Perform a +3 ranged strike for each character banished this way.

Name: Talisman of Faith
RulesText: Your clerics in this rank gain +1 AC.

Name: Talisman of Might
RulesText: Your fighters in this rank gain +1 ATK.

Name: Tattered Armaments
RulesText: Your deck may include any number of cards named Tattered Armaments.

Name: Taumar the Protector
RulesText: Each Deverenian Empire fighter in the rank in front of Taumar the Protector gains +2 AC and skill.

Name: Terrorize
RulesText:
Roll Order: Target a character within two ranks,
1-9: The target suffers -2 AC and skill this turn.
10-19: The target suffers -4 AC and skill this turn.
20: The target suffers -4 AC and skill this turn. Its controller banishes a card from their hand.

Name: Teufeltiger's Shroud
RulesText: Limited React: After this character is targeted by a strike: Redirect the strike to an adjacent character.

Name: TFK Brigand
RulesText: Strikes targeting TFK Brigand inflict an additional wound.\nSpend Order: Stun TFK Brigand: Perform a +0 ranged strike.

Name: The Mighty Mugg
RulesText: Limited Order: Target your adjacent equal or lower level character: Move the target forward up to two ranks. The target suffers a wound, then may perform a melee strike.

Name: The Quick and The Dead
RulesText: Spend Order: Each Warlord makes an initiative roll with a bonus equal to their ATK. If your Warlord wins the roll, your target character performs two melee strikes.

Name: Thicket
RulesText: Enter React: Characters in your first rank gain +3 AC while targeted with ranged strikes this turn.

Name: Throwing Shield
RulesText: Destroy Order: Perform a +0 ranged strike.

Name: Thunic Yeti
RulesText: Kill React: Characters that were adjacent to the killed character must succeed with a fortitude save (DC 18) or spend.

Name: Tide Turner
RulesText: Order: You may spend this character: Perform a +3 melee strike. If the strike hits, move the target backward one rank, or two ranks if you spent this character.

Name: Tinker
RulesText: Tinker may equip items regardless of class restrictions and gains +1 level for equipping them.

Name: Trap
RulesText: Destroy React: After target character targets this character with a strike: The target must succeed with a reflex save (DC 10) or suffer a wound.

Name: Tresven
RulesText: Enter React: Perform a +4 ranged strike that may only target a spent character.\nSpend Order: Perform a +1 ranged strike.

Name: Treyik
RulesText: After Treyik is discarded from your hand, you may put him into play.\nOrder: Kill one of your Undead: Target Elven Branches character gains +3 ATK and AC this turn.

Name: Treyik Netheryn
RulesText: React: After you discard a card from your hand: Banish it.\nSpend Order: Banish Treyik Netheryn: Put up to 3 cards banished using his other printed ability into your hand.

Name: Trinket of Malice
RulesText: When Trinket of Malice enters your discard pile, choose a character in an opposing first rank who suffers -2 AC and skill this turn, then banish Trinket of Malice.

Name: Trogid
RulesText: Death React: Your target Monster Journeys (moves forward or backward one rank).

Name: Tunnel Vanguard
RulesText: Adjacent Dwarven Forges characters gain +1 HP.

Name: Tunnel Worm
RulesText: Kill React: Move your target character in this rank to a different position in this rank.

Name: Tyren Ruskin
RulesText: Spend React: Before target character in this rank suffers wounds, wound Tyren: Reduce the wounds the target would suffer by one.

Name: Unicorn of Thun
RulesText: +2 Skill\nOrder: Spend Unicorn of Thun: Journey.\nOrder: Spend Unicorn of Thun and banish two action cards from your discard pile: Heal this character.

Name: Unsummon
RulesText: Spend Order: Return target unequipped character in a first rank to its owner's hand. If this character is a Warlock, Survey.

Name: Vactus, Spirit's Champion
RulesText: Limited Order: Move forward one rank.

Name: Valdimar
RulesText: Limited React: After an adjacent Dwarven Forges character equips an item: Ready Valdimar.

Name: Vanguard's Presence
RulesText: Spend Order: Spend Vanguard's Presence: Ready target lower level non-stunned character.

Name: Veera and Bones
RulesText: Enter React: Each opponent discards a card.\nDeath React: Each opponent discards a card. Banish Veera and Bones.

Name: Venomtipped Arrows
RulesText: React: After this character hits target character with a ranged strike: The target must succeed with a fortitude save (DC 13) or spend.

Name: Veteren Bowman
RulesText: Spend Order: Perform a +3 ranged strike.

Name: Viscous Goo
RulesText: Sutek may perform this action without spending.\nSpend Order: Perform a +5 ranged strike that stuns instead of wounds.

Name: Walk on Wind
RulesText: Order: Move another target character in this rank forward or backward one rank. If this character is a Shaman, this character may Journey.

Name: War Horse
RulesText: Order: Spend War Horse: Move forward one rank.\nOrder: Spend War Horse: Gain +2 ATK this turn.

Name: Warboss Azh'kal
RulesText: Your fighters who have moved this turn gain Powerattack +5.\nLimited Order: Target your fighter and choose two: The target moves forward one rank; gains +5 ATK this turn; gains advantage on their next melee strike this turn; or performs a melee strike.

Name: Wa'San Wolf-Spirit
RulesText: Limited Order: Perform a +4 ranged strike.\nLimited Order: Put an Animal token into play adjacent to Wa'San Wolf-Spirit.

Name: Well of Screams
RulesText: Spend Order: Reveal the top 10 cards of your deck. Each of your characters may equip one revealed item that they may legally equip. Then shuffle.

Name: Well Supplied
RulesText: Spend Order: Reveal the top 10 cards of your deck. Each of your characters may equip one revealed item that they may legally equip. Then shuffle.

Name: Wither
RulesText: Order: Perform a melee strike that does not inflict wounds. If the strike hits, the target suffers -3 levels this turn.

Name: Woestone
RulesText: This character suffers disadvantage on strike rolls.

Name: Wraithstalker
RulesText: Order: Spend Wraithstalker and discard the top two cards of your deck: Perform a melee strike targeting a character in the last rank of an opposing formation that inflicts an additional wound.

Name: Xcalam Coatl
RulesText: +3 skill\nOrder: Spend Xcalam Coatl: You and target opponent both reveal the top card of your decks. If your card is higher level, your next die roll this turn gains advantage.

Name: Yanthorine
RulesText: Yanthorine gains +1 level for casting spells.

Name: Z'adok, Prey Herder
RulesText: Your Sutek gain +2 to strike rolls while targeting spent characters.\nLimited Order: Perform a melee strike. Z'adok, Prey Herder gains Reach for the strike. If the strike hits, spend the target.

Name: Zaina
RulesText: React: After an opposing character targets Zaina with a non-melee strike action: Perform a melee strike.
